subject: Request: Demo window & trial extension due to integration blocker
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@heliohealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Li <chris@heliohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo timeline — integration blocker, request to extend trial

Hi Ben,

Quick update from our engineering side: Chris and the infra team hit a blocker with the SFTP connector — the library we rely on isn’t compatible with our staging environment and the workaround will take at least two sprints to land (we estimate ~5 business days). That’s pushed our demo readiness out of the originally planned window.

We’re still excited to move forward — the product fits our use case — but we’re going to miss the scheduled demo on Monday unless we postpone.

Could Redwood extend our trial sandbox and provide a small uplift of sandbox credits so our QA team can continue running end-to-end checks while we fix the adapter? If possible, we’d like the trial extended to 2026-09-30 and a temporary bump of 50k tokens for the month. We can share the integration logs for your engineering team to review.

Attaching a short log excerpt to help with triage.

Thanks for understanding — let me know if you need any more details.

Best,
Amit Shah
Senior Engineering Manager
HelioHealth

Attachment: integration-log.txt (plain text, 12KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo timeline — integration blocker, request to extend trial

Hi Amit — thanks for the quick heads up and for sending the log.

Sorry to hear about the SFTP incompatibility; that’s the sort of thing we want to avoid delaying a demo. I’ll loop in Marissa and Grace from our onboarding team to see what runway extension and credit uplift we can approve fast.

A few immediate items that will help speed our side:
- Could Chris share the exact node/lib versions and a snippet of the failing stack trace?
- Would you be available for a 30-minute pairing session tomorrow so one of our engineers can reproduce the failure in your staging?

I can usually approve a short demo reschedule from my side, but the 50k token bump needs a quick sign-off. Marissa — could you advise what approval path we should follow for a one-off sandbox credit uplift + trial extension to 2026-09-30?

Amit, if you can confirm availability for a pairing session (we have 9:30–12:00 PT tomorrow), I’ll reserve an engineer.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Direct: (415) 555-0192

Hi Ben / Marissa / Grace —

Thanks for the quick reply. Chris attached the fuller stack traces and the sprint plan so you can see the timeline. We are available for pairing tomorrow morning at 10:00 PT — Chris will join and can share a staging account.

To reiterate our ask: extend the trial sandbox access to 2026-09-30 and temporarily increase our token allotment by 50k for August/September while we work through the adapter rewrite. If there’s an internal form or PR you need us to complete, point us to it and we’ll fill it out today.

Appreciate you moving fast on this — the demo is a key milestone for our Q4 roadmap.

Best,
Amit

Attachments: sprint-plan.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@heliohealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Demo timeline — integration blocker, request to extend trial

Hi Amit — thanks for the details and for scheduling the pairing session with Chris. We were able to review the logs and sprint plan.

Approval: Redwood grants a trial extension to 2026-09-30 and a one-time sandbox credit uplift of 50,000 tokens for HelioHealth to use through September. This approval is issued as a courtesy given the integration blocker and the clear timeline you provided.

Notes:
- The uplift will be applied to your sandbox account by EOD Friday (14 Aug).
- Please confirm the exact staging account/email you want us to apply the credits to.
- We recommend the pairing session include a short triage agenda (15min repro, 15min mitigation plan). Ben — I’ve included Grace to help coordinate the technical pairing session.

If you need additional runway beyond 2026-09-30 because the blocker stretches longer, let us know and we can re-evaluate.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Onboarding Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
